Potential runtime exceptions include NullPointerException if card, game, or the result of game.getPlayer(playerId) is null, or if any of the called methods throw undocumented runtime exceptions. However, as runtime exceptions are not required to be caught and the method likely expects valid inputs, no optimization is necessary.
